coordinate_system: Blender meters, X right, Y forward, Z up. glTF conversion (x,z,-y).

shuttle.origin: Center of vehicle footprint, tire contact ground plane z=0
shuttle.wheel_spin_axis: local X in Blender and glTF; rotation increment = distance / .51
shuttle.door_animation: Not rigged; fixed closed two-leaf door geometry
shuttle.accuracy: 2025-10-15 Minju Chosun magazine p77 front/left livery visually verified; 2026-05-11 Chodae Newspaper p6 rear blue/white and CHOSUN UNIVERSITY corroborated. Right side mirrored inference. Stylized original geometry; exact model, dimensions, capture date and fleet-wide current identity unverified.
shuttle.lod: Static components batched by material; four separate wheel pivots. Recommended visibility 450m, shadow distance 100m. No mesh LOD swap required for this low-poly asset.

shelter.origin: Center of paving footprint, ground z=0
shelter.accuracy: Shelter form verified in 2021 Seollip Monument photograph; dimensions inferred. Only place this shelter at monument unless representative geometry is explicitly marked. Keep footprint behind sidewalk, never centered on route or crosswalk.

sign.accuracy: Monument label copied as original geometric text from readable photograph. Generic sign form at other stops is representative, not surveyed. Timetable lines are schematic, no operational times are invented.

placement.route_label: 공식 정류장 순서 기반 게임용 주행 경로
rules: Separate stop vehicle center from shelter/sign and safe waiting point
Do not treat landmark centers as measured curb stop locations
Check all existing destination approaches and crossing widths after adding collisions

height_modes.groundHeight: Sample caller height_fn(x,y) + item height_offset, default .025
height_modes.roadHeight: Sample caller height_fn(x,y) + item height_offset, default .105; campus road mesh uses same height_fn + .095

education_shelter.accuracy: 2021 College of Education photo-confirmed typology, inferred dimensions. Only for social_science / education stop; this is outside main seven-stop loop.
